meta.parties: De Silva v. Commissioner of Stamps

rules.statement: A dowry deed, even though it may be a conveyance for value, is still considered a gift and must be stamped under Article 30 of the Schedule.
rules.supporting_quote: "The Commissioner of Stamps decided that the deed should be stamped under Article 30 as a 'gift or deed of gift'. I think his decision is right. A dowry, though it may be given in consideration of marriage, is nevertheless, a gift."
